verdict.rationale: Wrike documents breaking large goals into tasks with assigned resources, plus Kanban/table views and dashboards for tracking work. This covers the core of tracking initiatives with ownership. The evidence never explicitly names status or priority fields, or assigning an owning team to an initiative. Missing for 10: explicit status fields on initiatives, priority fields, team-level ownership assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Break large goals into actionable tasks, assign resources, attach files and view project schedules at a glance.
See your work in our easy-to-understand, drag-and-drop Kanban board view.
Configure and tailor personalized dashboard to help track the work you need to see.
